segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello, this is Sam Rivera from Northbeam sales. This call is being recorded for our notes.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: The price for 60 seats is above our budget, honestly.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I hear you. I can do twenty-five percent off the list price if you sign this week.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That helps. Can you put it in writing, please?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I'll prepare the contract draft by Monday.
